name: Sustenance Replication Engine
description: An optimized digestion: no waste, and required food divided by Essence. Essence 5+ can forgo food entirely, synthesizing nutrients for 5 motes/day upkeep. Secondary mode bleeds a bland nutrient paste (5 motes + a minute per mortal meal) that carries little Essence.

name: Biofunction Inhibitor
description: Power down into a death-like regenerative torpor (a Perception + Medicine difficulty 4 detects faint life). Specify a wake time; the Exalt wakes early only if threatened with damage. Torpor rests by a factor of Essence (an Essence 4 Exalt compresses a night into two hours) and speeds Willpower recovery (one Conviction roll per 25 hours).

name: Toxicity Filtration Subsystems
description: Chemical filters add Essence automatic successes to all Stamina rolls/soak against toxins and purge alcohol and recreational drugs; rolling over twice the needed successes negates a poison entirely. Auto-activates against toxins (can be suppressed), otherwise preventing the Exalt from getting drunk or high.

name: Restorative Fusion Transponder
description: On a natural surface in Autochthonia, Primordial capillaries weave a cocoon (soak 10L/15B, 10 health levels) that heals and restores Essence as if resting in a Vat Complex, even under starvation. The Exalt can track recovery while unconscious and dismiss the cocoon at will.

name: Body-Reweaving Matrix
description: Spider automatons swarm wounds, regenerating Essence bashing levels per turn, one lethal per turn, one aggravated per 10 hours. Amputated organs regrow (a limb = three aggravated levels), and Charms in the lost area regrow if they were installed at the time of injury.

name: Diagnostic Sensor Apparatus
description: Fingertip sensors scan a living target within Essence yards (one turn), the data held while Essence is committed. Interpreting it (Intelligence + Medicine, five minutes per roll, extended) reveals from alive/well (1 success) up to full disease profiling and magical/mundane nature (5 successes).

name: Biosight Reticle
description: Diagnostic lenses show animating Essence glowing: add each target's Essence to Perception rolls to spot hidden beings, negate darkness/fog penalties, scan through a yard of matter, and pierce concealment Charms of equal/lesser Essence (opposed roll). Study a being (Perception + Medicine) to read health levels, wound/fatigue penalties, Essence, Stamina/Endurance/Resistance, injuries, pregnancy, parasites or disease.

name: Biostasis Field Projector
description: A touch (or won clinch) induces a stabilizing coma (Stamina + Resistance vs Essence to resist): infections/poisons halt, bleeding stops, the mortally wounded hold at Incapacitated for a day. Reflexively (3 motes + a Stamina dot), an Exalt taking lethal past Incapacitated survives at Incapacitated in coma for at least an hour, repeatable until Stamina 1 or out of Essence.

name: Multifunction Hypodermic Apparatus

submodules.name: Paralytic Toxin
submodules.description: Numbing bashing damage (Intelligence + Medicine, natural soak) and an Essence dice penalty for Intelligence hours; success halves it.

submodules.name: Lethal Toxin
submodules.description: As Paralytic Toxin but lethal; mortals die after convulsing for Stamina turns.

submodules.name: Acid
submodules.description: 6L (natural soak only, no resistance roll); three+ levels from one dose permanently reduces Appearance by 1.

submodules.name: Antivenin
submodules.description: Cancels one poison in the system (most potent first), removing effects and healing same-scene poison damage; also cleanses alcohol/drugs, and preemptively inoculates for an hour.

submodules.name: Anesthetic
submodules.description: Subtract Essence from all wound penalties; suppressed dice return one per hour (reinjection resets, not stacks).

submodules.name: Immune Booster
submodules.description: +1 die to Stamina rolls against disease for Intelligence days.

submodules.name: Antiseptic
submodules.description: Injected into a wound, prevents infection and nullifies existing infection.

submodules.name: Healing Agent
submodules.description: With an hour of rest, heal two bashing levels.

submodules.name: Coagulant
submodules.description: Blood thickens; all bleeding stops immediately.

submodules.name: Hallucinogen
submodules.description: Synesthesia and pleasure; failure gives an (Intelligence + Essence) dice penalty (fading hourly) and month-long addiction (Temperance difficulty 2).

submodules.name: Stimulant
submodules.description: Reduce fatigue penalty by Essence for Intelligence hours; each dose past the first without rest deals two unsoakable bashing.

submodules.name: Time Release Drug
submodules.description: Designate a delay when injecting any other drug; it stays inert until the time passes, then resolves.

submodules.name: Memory Eraser
submodules.description: A neurotoxin: failure knocks the target out for a minute and erases the past hour/scene; success scrambles memory (reflexive Wits per event). Not a starting formula.

submodules.name: Triggered Activation Drug
submodules.description: Commit 1 mote to hold any injected drug inert for a month; the Exalt can trigger or disarm it at will. Not a starting formula.

description: A two-yard needle-tentacle injecting drugs synthesized from Essence (Dexterity + Medicine as an attack vs the unwilling; harmful drugs allow a Stamina + Resistance roll vs Essence). Comes with any TWO formulas free; each additional costs 2 bonus points or 4 experience. (The 'two free' allotment is not auto-tracked here.)

name: Regenerative Essence Transfusion
description: Inject a mortal (via the Hypodermic) so they heal and resist poison/disease as an Exalt while the Exalt commits 10 motes. Secondary: transfer motes through the needle - donate up to (Stamina + Essence) motes, or siphon (2 motes; Intelligence + Medicine; 2 motes per success, Peripheral first).

name: Metabolic Augmentation Injection
description: Inject a physical-enhancement drug (no resistance): 3 motes raises a Physical Attribute, Appearance, Perception or Wits by a dot; 1 mote per dot raises Athletics/Awareness/Endurance/Resistance. No trait past (Exalt's Essence - patient's Essence) dots, doubled original, or Ability 5. Lasts while Essence is committed; week-long carriers may pay XP to keep gains. Highly addictive to mortals.
